chunks: A group informed me of it from Abū Muḥammad Hārūn ibn Mūsā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Saʿīd, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl; and Aḥmad ibn ʿAbdūn informed me from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn al-Zubayr, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd, from Yaḥyā ibn ʿImrān al-Ḥalabī, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Miskān, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
"Whoever has intercourse with a menstruating woman, then half a dīnār is upon him, which he gives in charity."
And this is to be understood as applying when the intercourse occurred in the middle of the menstruation period.

key_terms.نِصْفُ دِينَارٍ: half a dīnār as the specified financial amount
key_terms.وَسَطِ الْحَيْضِ: the middle of the menstruation period

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām for intercourse with a menstruating woman?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning intercourse during menstruation, stating that half a dīnār should be given in charity. The appended statement explains that this ruling is understood to apply specifically when the intercourse occurs in the middle of the menstrual period.
